title: Low heat that isn't noticeable 3 feet away
text: Low heat that isn't noticeable 3 feet away. At best, this little heater is suitable for under a desk. It puts out very little heat via the blower. You can adjust the temperature a bit with a knob, but we literally couldn't tell a difference.  The fan option is not powerful enough to heat even a tiny room. I hoped this would supplement the regular heat in a big closet space, but if you are more than 2 feet from the heater you cannot feel it at all. There are far better options available than this one.

product_metadata.title: Comfort Zone CZ360BK 360° Ceramic Heater with Safety Tip-over Switch, Black
features: FULL 360 DEGREE HEAT OUTPUT: The 1500w heat output flows from the top of the unit for a full 360 degree solution. The On/Off light clearly indicates when unit is in use
SAFETY FEATURES: To help ensure safe operation, a sensor switches the unit off whenever it overheats and a tip-over cutoff switch shuts it off if it is accidentally knocked over.
SIMPLE SETTINGS: The electric portable heater/fan boasts two powerful heat settings and a single fan-only setting that you can easily switch between using a simple control knob on the front.
FAN ONLY SETTING: A fan-only setting allows you to use this portable heater fan to keep cool during the warmer months, making it a smart addition to your space all-year round.
ADJUSTABLE THERMOSTAT: The heater comes with an adjustable thermostat to make sure you are comfortable and stay-cool body housing and molded handle allow for safe transportation.
description: Warm up small rooms in your home or office with this handy ceramic heater from Comfort Zone. The electric portable heater/fan boasts two powerful heat settings and a single fan-only setting that you can easily switch between using a simple control knob on the front. The heat flows from the top of the unit and out from the bottom of the unit for a full 360 degree solution. A fan-only setting allows you to use this portable heater fan to keep cool during the warmer months, making it a smart addition to your space all-year round. To help ensure safe operation, a sensor switches the unit off whenever it overheats and a tip-over cutoff switch shuts it off if it is accidentally knocked over.
